subject: general
question: In 1955 a special committee known as the Karve Committee was constituted. This committee advised:

options.text: the promotion of small-scale industries for the purpose of rural development
the promotion of the agriculture sector
the rapid export of cotton and fresh fruits
the promotion of large industries for the purpose of urban development

solution:
The correct answer is __**the promotion of small-scale industries for the purpose of rural development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Karve Committee was established in 1955 to focus on rural development through the promotion of small-scale industries.
 
• The committee emphasized the importance of developing rural industries to reduce the gap between urban and rural economies.
 
• Recommendations included providing financial assistance, technical support, and training to rural artisans and small-scale entrepreneurs.
 
• The committee's work led to the development of policies aimed at decentralizing industrial growth and promoting self-employment in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Small-Scale Industries (SSI):**

 
 
• SSIs are industries with a small investment in plant and machinery, and they play a crucial role in the Indian economy by generating employment and promoting industrialization in rural areas.
 
• They often include sectors like handicrafts, handloom, and agro-based industries.
 
 
 
• **Rural Development:**
 
 
• Rural development focuses on improving the quality of life and economic well-being of people living in rural areas, often through infrastructure development, education, and healthcare.
 
 
 
• **Technical Support and Training:**
 
 
• Providing technical support and training to rural entrepreneurs helps in skill development and enhances the productivity and quality of goods produced.
 
 
 
• **Financial Assistance:**
 
 
• Access to financial resources, such as loans and grants, is essential for the growth of small-scale industries, enabling them to invest in new technologies and expand their operations.
 
 
 
• **Decentralized Industrial Growth:**
 
 
• This approach aims to spread industrial activities across various regions rather than concentrating them in a few urban areas, thus promoting balanced regional development.
